score_semantics: Source-contract confidence only; not parcel-result or numeric elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model 1m
verified_facts: The product is a 1m raster terrain model covering approximately 99 percent of England
Surface objects are removed to create a bare-earth terrain model
The 2022 composite uses the newest best-resolution survey where repeats exist
Bilinear interpolation was used where source surveys were resampled before merging
semantic_limits: Composite coverage does not prove which exact tile bytes were sampled
Resampled pixels must retain survey lineage and cannot be described as original observations
The product remains unusable for a parcel until exact polygon and raster overlap are proven

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue ASCII to GeoTIFF guidance
verified_facts: Environment Agency composite DTM products moved from ASCII to GeoTIFF
GeoTIFF files are supplied in 5km tiles
Elevation values are expressed in metres
GeoTIFF supports georeferencing and more efficient storage and web services
semantic_limits: A file extension alone does not prove CRS, transform, vertical datum or validity mask
Downloaded bytes must be hashed and inspected before use
A web service preview cannot substitute for the exact raster tile used in the result

candidates.name: OGC GeoTIFF 1.1 Standard
verified_facts: GeoTIFF defines requirements and encoding rules for georeferenced or geocoded TIFF imagery
GeoTIFF 1.1 aligns geospatial keys with the EPSG geodetic parameter dataset
The standard is used to exchange geographic raster imagery and grid data
semantic_limits: Conformance to GeoTIFF does not guarantee a correct parcel match
The actual raster tags and coordinate reference must be inspected per file
The standard does not define the project-specific polygon inclusion rule

candidates.name: GDAL RFC 15 Band Masks
verified_facts: GDAL exposes validity masks for raster bands
Mask value zero indicates invalid data and non-zero indicates valid data
Masks can derive from nodata values, alpha bands or external mask files
A dataset with no explicit invalidity may expose an all-valid mask
semantic_limits: An all-valid mask does not prove the source has complete physical coverage
Nodata must never enter minimum or maximum statistics
Interpolated fill values cannot silently replace missing primary terrain observations

candidates.name: GDAL raster zonal statistics and rasterization semantics
verified_facts: Pixel inclusion may use centre, all-touched or fractional coverage semantics
All-touched includes every pixel touched by the polygon
Fractional mode weights pixels by the fraction covered by the polygon
Maximum values are not changed by fractional weighting even when coverage fractions are calculated
semantic_limits: Centre, all-touched and fractional results are not interchangeable
The selected policy and software version must be retained with every result
Tiny or edge-only polygons require an explicit fallback rather than silent method switching
